name: Chao long
summary: Cháo lòng is rice porridge with pork offal, a breakfast on Da Nang’s Huỳnh Thúc Kháng, in the same morning row as xôi, bánh cuốn, and cháo trắng.
origin: Huỳnh Thúc Kháng, Da Nang’s breakfast street.
howToEat: Eat it in the morning on Huỳnh Thúc Kháng.
where: Huỳnh Thúc Kháng, in the morning. The street is busiest from about 06:00 to 08:00, and counters serve until around noon.
seoTitle: Chao long — breakfast porridge on Huynh Thuc Khang
seoDescription: Cháo lòng is a breakfast porridge on Huỳnh Thúc Kháng, with xôi, bánh cuốn, and cháo trắng.
